verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Cline can run automations, including cron-scheduled agents, headless CLI runs, and skills. It never documents versioning, review, or rollback of those automation definitions. The diffs, checkpoints, one-click undo and Kanban diff review apply to the code edits the agent makes, an adjacent feature rather than managing the automations themselves.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
